name: Billy Doe Meats

performance.verdict: ROAS still healthy at 4.73x but 3-day purchase collapse demands spend restoration now.

findings.text: 3-day purchases: Sep 12–14 = 0+1+0 vs Sep 9–11 = 0+2+5. Revenue flatlined at $0 last 2 days despite $55–63/day spend.
Spend pulled back 18.36% 7d vs prior 7d ($52.53/day avg), directly reducing delivery on the only producing campaign BWS - Sales - Muslims ($840.32 of $1,479.52 28d spend).
OVERDUE: Funnel test closed + UTM live (due Aug 31, Ads — Meta) and Pre-launch gate cleared (due Aug 31, Admin) have no completion event recorded.
OVERDUE: Aug 14 live-cooking event (Video/Content) and Platform ownership audit (CRM & Automation, due Aug 31) both remain unresolved with no completion logged.
GBP actions dropped 50% 7d vs prior 7d; Sep 13–14 show 0 GBP actions, suggesting a data gap or listing issue, not an organic decline.

suggestions.text: Restore Meta daily budget to ~$70/day (+18%), reversing the spend pullback that dropped purchases to zero.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta daily budget was pulled back ~18% (avg $52.53/day last 7 days vs prior period), coinciding with purchases collapsing to 0 on Sep 12 and Sep 14 and $0 revenue on both days. Restore budget to ~$70/day on BWS - Sales - Muslims — the campaign that drove $840.32 of the 28-day $1,479.52 spend at a 4.73x ROAS. Success check: 2+ purchases within 3 days of restoration (by Sep 18) with ROAS holding above 4.0x.

suggestions.text: Confirm GBP listing is active; zero actions on Sep 13–14 may indicate a listing suspension or data pull failure.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit 0 on both Sep 13 and Sep 14, after averaging 13–47/day across the prior 40 days. Log in to Google Business Profile and confirm the listing is live, not suspended, and that the data pipeline is returning results. Success check: GBP actions resume reporting by Sep 18; if the listing was suspended, document the cause for the file.

suggestions.text: Watch Sep 15–17 purchase count; if still 0 after spend restoration, flag creative fatigue on BWS - Sales - Muslims for refresh.
suggestions.monday_update: After restoring the Meta budget to $70/day (S1), monitor purchases on Sep 15–17. The 28-day ROAS is 4.73x but the last 3 days returned 1 purchase on $156/spend — that is a 4.8x ROAS floor at risk. If purchases remain at 0–1 by Sep 18, escalate to Nacer for a creative refresh on BWS - Sales - Muslims using the real facility footage delivered July 21. Re-check date: Sep 18.
